answer: The mesa I would price into every new account is Lorry tachograph record with fleet operator attestation: each record is months of driving hours logged by a fleet operator, so a farm must run a hundred real lorries, and no farm can amortise that across a thousand names. The attacker pays per clone — new hardware, new credentials, new history — while the ridge for the defender stays flat, a single verification per account. The reef is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
